entities.name: Aladdin
entities.description: Rogue from Rabiah famous for his lamp, his ring and artifact-thieving skills.

entities.name: magician
entities.description: Gave Aladdin a destructive ring as a supposed talisman against evil.

events.summary: A magician gifts Aladdin a destructive ring, telling him it is a talisman as long as he keeps obeying.
events.quote: Aladdin's destructive ring was gifted by a magician

relations.note: Received the ring from him on condition of obedience.
relations.quote: as long as Aladdin kept obeying the magician.
